catalog_description: The IAS-O3b catalog contains 23 binary black hole mergers in the public data from the second half of the third observing run (O3b) of advanced LIGO and advanced Virgo. Of these, 6 were reported there for the first time.

links.description: Zenodo release with posterior samples for the IAS O3b catalog.
Zenodo release with posterior samples for the IAS O3b catalog.

events.event_description: False-alarm rates are computed within each template bank; the search used 6 independent template banks. However, we also report global false-alarm rates which are combined over all the template banks. The reported SNR is that recovered by the search pipeline, which includes the LIGO Hanford and Livingston detectors only. See Mehta et al. (2025) for details.
